title: Hyperlapse on the move
summary: A sped-up clip from a car, bike or walk.

blocks.note: Long, steady journeys make the smoothest result.

steps: Mount the camera firmly facing the way you're travelling.
Pick a route with things passing: traffic, trees, lights.
Lock white balance so colours don't jump.
Start recording and keep a steady speed.
Trim the start and end later.

items: Inside a car: lens close to the windscreen to cut reflections, and clean the glass.
Walking: hold it at chest height and walk smoothly.

steps: Mount it: suction cup in the car, handlebar or chest strap on a bike, or handheld. Tighten the locking screws.
Swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list and choose **Hyperlapse**, the mode for a moving camera.
Swipe up to set the speed-up and resolution options.
Turn on **Orientation Lock** and **Screen Lock** in the control menu.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: DJI's support page confirms the mode but not its options. Check the settings screen.

dji-lito-x1.note: For the drone, use Drone hyperlapse.
